description: Defines the ShopOrder class representing an order in the e-commerce system, including shopping cart items, shipping, payment details, and order summary.

classes.name: ShopOrder
classes.description: Represents a customer's order with details such as items, shipping, payment, and totals.

methods.name: setShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart items for the order.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of shopping cart items.

methods.name: setOrderTotalSummary
methods.description: Sets the order total summary that displays the total cost.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves any error messages associated with the order process.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets an error message for the order.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodType
methods.description: Gets the type of payment method chosen.
